sites.name: Convict Lake Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $35 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: A short walk from Convict Lake, the campground is located along Convict Creek. There are85 campsites with bear lockers at each campsite. Many sites are flat and suitable for RVs. shower hookups are not available. Showers may be purchased at near by Convict Lake Resort. Dump station is located…
sites.directions: Located two miles off Highway 395 between Mammoth Lakes and Bishop, west of the Mammoth Yosemite Airport.
sites.restrictions: Dogs must always be on leash and under owner control. Maximum stay 14 days. Active bear area. All food must be secured overnight and when not attended; bear boxes are provided and must be used (typical bear box size 48" x 30" x 36"). Always keep a clean camp and do not feed wildlife.
